title: 79% of These Car Wash Sales Are Subscriptions #shorts
summary: In Q4 2025, 79% of Mister Car Wash's wash sales came from its Unlimited Wash Club, about 2.3 million members on auto-renewing monthly plans.
sources: Mister Car Wash FY2025 results (8-K Ex. 99.1, Feb 18, 2026): net revenues $1,051.7M; adjusted EBITDA $345.4M; net income $103.1M; "Ended the quarter with approximately 2.3 million UWC members"; "UWC sales represented 79% of total wash sales" in Q4 2025: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1853513/000119312526056047/d113732dex991.htm
Mister Car Wash membership terms: "YOUR UWC MEMBERSHIP PLAN WILL AUTOMATICALLY RENEW MONTHLY": https://mistercarwash.com/member-terms

scenes.narration: {79 percent|Seventy-nine percent} of the wash sales at Mister Car Wash came from members paying monthly.
That's about {2.3 million|two point three million} people on an unlimited plan.
Rain or shine, the plan renews every month.
Your car wash isn't selling washes. It's selling the plan.
